triage.summary: Sarah Kim, practice manager for two dental clinics in Austin, asks whether Alex can build a website chatbot that answers questions about cleaning prices, insurance, and opening hours, and books appointments in Google Calendar. She requests a rough cost and timeline.

task.title: Prepare a rough quote and timeline for Sarah's chatbot
task.description: Sarah Kim of two dental clinics in Austin asks for a website chatbot to answer questions about cleaning prices, insurance, and opening hours, and book appointments in Google Calendar. Reply with a rough cost and estimated build timeline.

reply.body:
Hi Sarah,

Thanks for reaching out. I’d be happy to learn more about the chatbot you have in mind and put together a rough cost and timeline. Could you share your website and any details about how you’d like appointment booking to work?

Best,
Alex
